name: Specsight
summary: Product observability that learns features from code and turns releases into plain-language updates.
description: Specsight connects read-only to code repositories, maintains a live product spec/feature map, and generates plain-language product updates and release notes for support, sales, marketing and leadership. Differentiator is a living product map derived from code rather than manually written docs. Standard plan is €150/month (up to 3 projects, 50 members, 200 syncs); 7-day free trial available; 14-day money-back on first payment.
features: Live product spec and feature map derived from code
Plain-language product updates and release notes
Updates aimed at support, sales, marketing and leadership
